title: Booking policy dump
description: The ONLY artifact that leaves the owner's device. Anything absent here is absent by design, not by omission — see design/booking-architecture.md section 2.

expires.description: After this the service stops serving the dump, so a device that goes quiet cannot leave stale availability up forever.

name.description: The single identifying field in the whole document, chosen by the owner in the knowledge that it is public.

tz.description: IANA zone, for showing the owner's local time beside the requester's.

title.description: Set by the owner, never by the requester — stranger-supplied text does not belong in someone's calendar title.

slots.description: Offerable slots as UTC instants. NOT free/busy: the absence of a slot may be a meeting or may be policy, and the page cannot tell which.
